newsitem.title: UK: FORD details $1.04 bln asset-backed notes.
newsitem.headline: FORD details $1.04 bln asset-backed notes.

text.p: Ford Motor Credit 1996-B has issued five tranches of asset-backed notes for a total of $1.04 billion, lead manager Merrill Lynch said.
